_: Road types by OSM way id (issue #67), read by scripts/build-data.mjs. unmarked-1, unmarked-2, unmarked-3: a carriageway of that many lanes (3.5 m each, plus 0.5 m), drawn without lane dashes or lamps, for the slip roads of junctions and roundabouts. Every highway=*_link way is already laid as unmarked-<its lanes tag> (1 one-way, 2 two-way when untagged); list a way here to give a slip road mapped as an ordinary street a type, or `marked` to keep a link at its class width with its dashes. A narrow street mapped at its class width takes a type here too: đường Lê Văn Hưu on the Kim Oanh dyke and the north-west bank of hồ Tịnh Tâm (39416158, 1489626239; lane_markings=no) is a 5–7 m lane between the water and the houses (Street View, Nov 2026), not a 6.5 m carriageway with pavements.
